text:
maria: quick heads-up — my flight's delayed, won't make the 18:00 primary handoff in person. need someone to cover primary 18:00-22:00 PST tonight. i'm on mobile, leaving a short walk-through below. sorry for the short notice.

oncall-bot: @maria — automatic note created for on-call rotation. Please confirm swap intent in-thread. (incidentbot)

liam: I can pick up primary 18:00-22:00. i'll shadow from 17:30 and take over at 18. I'll keep my phone on and set DND overrides for the pager. :thumbsup:

tanvi: I'll take secondary for 18-22. will ensure runbook links are up in the channel and confirm access to the customer logs.

maria: thank you liam + tanvi. couple of quick context bullets:
- current active incident: intermittent 503s hitting the reranker for eu-region customers (not widespread, ~2% of requests).
- last mitigations applied: scaled reranker pool + prefix kv cache warmup at 16:12.
- current impact: degraded latency and some 503s for retries from EU, severity P2 right now.

maria: runbook pointers: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/reranker-503s (please read the "quick triage" section). Key commands i used:```
# warm cache
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/reranker-eu
# temporarily disable retries at api-gw
curl -X POST https://infra-api.local/configs/retries -d '{"enabled":false}'
```

liam: got the runbook. quick Q: any rate-limit knobs we should temporarily relax for customers?

tanvi: we shouldn't relax rate-limits yet. better to maintain guardrails and watch queue depth. i'll watch queue-depth dashboards (link: https://grafana.redwood/dashboard/queue-depths).

liam: ok. plan from me: 17:30 shadow check, verify reranker pods are stable, watch error budget, and be prepared to roll back to previous model tag if error rate >5% for 10m. i'll post actions.

ops-bot: Escalation policy snapshot — primary response window 0-15m; if no ack, notify secondary; 15-45m -> L2 paging; 45m+ -> L3. Pager channels: #pager-prod, #pager-eu.

maria: also leaving a short note for customers: we've already opened a support ticket for affected tenants and tagged engineering priority. if anything customer-visible spikes, escalate immediately and ping @tanvi.

liam: performing pre-handoff checklist now:
1) confirm creds: OK
2) confirm runbook accessible: OK
3) confirm dashboard alerts connected: OK
4) set temporary routing rule (if needed): will coordinate with infra team

liam: executing the handoff command now:```incidentctl handoff --from maria --to liam --at 18:00 --note "flight delay swap"```

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: from maria -> liam at 18:00 (scheduled). Secondary: tanvi. See /incidents/1798884444 for thread linkage.

tanvi: I added a quick watchlist in the runbook with the two err logs to grep:```
# tails
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/reranker-eu -c model --since=10m | grep "503"
kubectl -n api logs deploy/api-gw -c gateway --since=15m | tail -n 200
```

maria: one more operational note — if you have to roll the reranker, prefer a canary to 10% first and watch latency; we saw memory pressure on full roll at 16:00.

liam: acknowledged. i'll set a canary and monitor memory metrics. i'll post status updates every 15 minutes in this thread.

tanvi: i'll be online for the window and will take over if liam gets paged away. leaving a pinned checklist in the channel. :white_check_mark:

maria: thank you all — leaving the plane now. tagging support leads @ops on call if anything customer-facing pops up. safe handoff. :airplane:

liam: confirmed handoff. first status update in ~15m.

oncall-bot: Thread note: last activity recorded at 1798884720.
